name: Valdris, The Anvil-Born

valdris_idle@loop.maps_to: alive, not moving, out of combat (no enemy near, no attack for 2 s; hub)
valdris_idle@loop.purpose: relaxed heavy stance: slow deep breaths lift the pauldrons, the weight rolls between the feet, a slow look around

valdris_idle_combat@loop.maps_to: alive, not moving, in combat (enemies near or an attack in the last 2 s). Frame 0 is the reference pose of every upper-layer clip
valdris_idle_combat@loop.purpose: combat stance: planted wide, the cannon down the aim, a heavy breathing sink on the knees

valdris_walk@loop.maps_to: moving at under about 55 % of move speed (stick partly pushed, slows); playback rate = speed / 1.70 m/s
valdris_walk@loop.purpose: heavy walk: a wide rolling gait, the weight dropping onto each sabaton, the cannon swinging low

valdris_run@loop.maps_to: moving within 45 deg of the aim at move speed; playback rate = speed / 5.6 m/s
valdris_run@loop.purpose: juggernaut run: low and heavy, the pelvis sinks on every footfall, the cannon held down the aim, the fist pumping

valdris_strafe_left@loop.maps_to: moving 45-135 deg to the left of the aim; playback rate = speed / 5.6 m/s
valdris_strafe_left@loop.purpose: side run to his left: the hips open toward the travel, the chest and the cannon kept on the aim

valdris_strafe_right@loop.maps_to: moving 45-135 deg to the right of the aim; playback rate = speed / 5.6 m/s
valdris_strafe_right@loop.purpose: side run to his right (the chest and the cannon kept on the aim)

valdris_backpedal@loop.maps_to: moving more than 135 deg away from the aim; playback rate = speed / 5.6 m/s
valdris_backpedal@loop.purpose: heavy backpedal: short driving steps, the weight forward over the cannon, the cannon on the aim

valdris_dash.maps_to: the 0.16 s dash (MoverState.dash_left > 0); the client faces the hero along the dash for its duration
valdris_dash.purpose: the dash burst: a low bull rush behind the anvil and both pauldrons, the cannon low and forward

valdris_dash_recover.maps_to: the first 0.5 s after a dash ends when the hero is not moving on (else blend into locomotion)
valdris_dash_recover.purpose: out of the dash: the lead sabaton slams down, the rear one after it, a heavy absorb on both knees

valdris_fire_light.maps_to: each primary shot of a light chassis (fire_rate >= 2/s): the colossus_cannon's 2.6 shots/s
valdris_fire_light.purpose: a cannon shot: the muzzle kicks up, the shoulder and chest take it, the weight settles back (recoil stays procedural)

valdris_fire_heavy.maps_to: a heavy / charged release (fire_rate < 1/s, charge release, splash chassis)
valdris_fire_heavy.purpose: a heavy shot: brace into it, the cannon bucks up and drives the shoulder back, a slow settle

valdris_fire_charge@loop.maps_to: fire held on a Charge chassis (FireKind::Charge) until release (then fire_heavy)
valdris_fire_charge@loop.purpose: holding a charge: braced into the cannon, the fist clenched, the barrel trembling with stored power

valdris_hit_light.maps_to: PlayerFlags::HIT on a light hit (damage < 10 % max HP), layered over whatever plays
valdris_hit_light.purpose: a flinch: the chest and pauldrons rock back, the cannon knocked off the aim, absorbed at once

valdris_hit_heavy.maps_to: PlayerFlags::HIT on a heavy hit (damage >= 10 % max HP or a stun); interrupts upper-layer clips
valdris_hit_heavy.purpose: a big stagger: rocked back, the lead sabaton steps back, a deep absorb on both knees, stepping back in

valdris_knockdown.maps_to: a knockback / launch strong enough to floor the hero (stun >= 0.8 s); holds its last frame until get_up
valdris_knockdown.purpose: floored: rocked back off the lead foot, a stagger step back, then crashing down onto one knee, propped on the cannon

valdris_get_up.purpose: shoving up off the knee, the rear sabaton stamps forward under him, the lead foot resets, back into the stance

valdris_death.maps_to: LifeState::Downed begins (GameEvent::Downed); holds its last frame, then downed@loop (wraith look)
valdris_death.purpose: the fatal blow: rocked back, a knee gives and he crashes down onto it, then slumps over his knee and the cannon, a statue

valdris_downed@loop.maps_to: LifeState::Downed (the Soul-Tether wraith; moves at 45 % speed with no gait, the client adds the ghost material)
valdris_downed@loop.purpose: the wraith drift: slumped, floating off the ground, the cannon and the fist hanging, a slow heavy bob

valdris_revive.maps_to: an ally completes the Soul-Tether revive (Downed -> Alive)
valdris_revive.purpose: dragged back into the body: a jolt, the sabatons slam down, a deep crouch, up into the stance

valdris_reforge_in.maps_to: LifeState::Reforging ends: the hero reappears next to an ally
valdris_reforge_in.purpose: forged anew: rises off one knee (propped on the cannon), stamps in and throws both arms wide as the seams flare

valdris_victory.maps_to: the run is won (GameEvent victory / boss down, results screen); holds its last frame
valdris_victory.purpose: the roar: a crouch, then the cannon and the fist thrown up to the sky, chest out; holds the pose

valdris_ping.purpose: a ping: the left gauntlet thrusts out with the hand open, pointing ahead, the head follows

valdris_interact.maps_to: the interact input at an anvil / forge / shrine POI (PoiState use); 1.3 s
valdris_interact.purpose: work the anvil: a step in, lean over and press the plated fist down onto it, then step back

valdris_forge_hammer@loop.maps_to: the forge / hub anvil upgrade (Forge screen open, hub idle at the anvil)
valdris_forge_hammer@loop.purpose: hammering the anvil with the plated left fist, the cannon arm braced at his side

valdris_idle_signature@loop.maps_to: alive and idle for 6 s or more (out of combat); in the hub and the character select
valdris_idle_signature@loop.purpose: signature idle: a forge-deep breath vents the pauldron slots, he lifts the cannon to look down the barrel, flexes the fist

valdris_bulwark_slam.maps_to: kits.ron valdris active1 Bulwark Slam: the 7 m / 0.45 s leap runs from 'launch' to 'land' (the sim moves the entity); Nova (r 3.4) on 'land', the forge Barricade on 'barricade'
valdris_bulwark_slam.purpose: Bulwark Slam: a deep crouch, a heavy leap with both arms raised overhead, the cannon slammed down on landing

valdris_siege_stance_enter.maps_to: kits.ron valdris active2 Siege Stance cast: rooted from 'anchor' (the anchor VFX / ground glyph); then siege_stance@loop
valdris_siege_stance_enter.purpose: Siege Stance: two stamping steps out into a wide low brace, the fist planted on the knee, the cannon locked on the aim

valdris_siege_stance@loop.maps_to: replaces idle_combat and locomotion for the 6 s Siege Stance (rooted); siege_fire layers the shots over it
valdris_siege_stance@loop.purpose: the Siege Stance brace: rooted wide and low, the fist on the knee, heavy breaths, the cannon dead steady

valdris_siege_stance_exit.maps_to: Siege Stance ends (6 s): back to idle_combat / locomotion
valdris_siege_stance_exit.purpose: out of the brace: he straightens and steps both sabatons back in under him

valdris_siege_fire.maps_to: each shot during Siege Stance (5.7 shots/s = one per 5.3 frames), layered over siege_stance@loop; first and last frame are siege_stance frame 0
valdris_siege_fire.purpose: a Siege Stance shot: a short hard kick of the cannon and the right shoulder, braced (recoil stays procedural)

valdris_mountainfall_start.maps_to: kits.ron valdris ultimate Mountainfall cast: the x1.8 scale ramps from 'grow', the first shockwave on 'stomp'; then mountainfall@loop
valdris_mountainfall_start.purpose: Mountainfall: gathers low, steps wide and rises with both arms flung out and up as he grows, a ground-shaking stamp

valdris_mountainfall@loop.maps_to: replaces idle_combat while Mountainfall lasts (8 s, model scale x1.8); shots and mountainfall_pound layer on top
valdris_mountainfall@loop.purpose: the Mountainfall avatar stance: wider and lower, heavy slow breaths rolling the pauldrons, the cannon on the aim

valdris_mountainfall_pound.maps_to: every 1.1 s during Mountainfall (33 frames = 1.1 s): the pound (r 4.5) on 'pound'; upper layer over mountainfall@loop or locomotion, first and last frame are mountainfall frame 0
valdris_mountainfall_pound.purpose: the Mountainfall ground pound: both arms heaved overhead, then the cannon and the fist hammered down at the ground

valdris_armor_break.maps_to: the Reforged Flesh passive when the Armor breaks: the shockwave (r 5.0) and the 3 s taunt start on 'break'; upper layer over anything
valdris_armor_break.purpose: Reforged Flesh break: hunched against the blow, then the chest and both arms thrown open in a roar as the plates blast off

playback.locomotion: playback rate = ground speed / clip_info.design_speed_mps (walk, run, strafe_*, backpedal)
playback.upper_layer: layer 'upper' clips: mask spine_01 and its children over locomotion; their first and last frames are valdris_idle_combat@loop frame 0, except the clips whose clip_info.<clip>.base names another clip (valdris_mountainfall_pound, valdris_siege_fire): theirs are frame 0 of that clip
playback.events: glTF has no events: clip_info.<clip>.events gives the frame and time of each (30 fps)
playback.weapon_variant: clip_info.<clip>.weapon_variant is null: colossus_cannon has no hand variants, so nothing swaps. The fist / open hand poses are the hero's own keyed fingers; clip_info.<clip>.hand_pose lists them per hand for reference
playback.in_place: only pelvis translates; the entity moves in the sim

weapon.attach: weapon scene = identity child of weapon_R (a sleeve weapon: the right forearm lies in its sleeve, the fist on its inner handle); it has no offhand node, the left hand is the hero's own

axes: glTF +Y up, 1 unit = 1 m. The hero faces +Z, origin on the ground between the feet, rest pose = T-pose. Socket nodes: -Z = forward (grip +Y), +Y = up, +X = right; a weapon scene attaches as an identity child.

warnings: rest height 2.33 m outside the hero range (2.0, 2.3)
